main_switch2.description: Studio v1.4: everything in Studio v1.3 (10 presets), with new heat-up and ready lights. Heating: the whole ring at 12% red, filling to full from both sides as it heats. At temperature: full green on the whole ring, fading from the top down to 12% as the hold runs out. No red flash at heat start or at temperature. Safety limits are unchanged.
